Ronan Tools, Inc. is a cutting tool manufacturing company.

John Ronan began designing and making tools out of his garage in Downey, California in 1987. Ronan Tools first big success was the Sears Craftsman “Handi-Cut” in 1996. The company’s tremendous achievement at Sears can be measured by this tool selling over 5 million to date!
